interpretation: Every owner/mode scores82nominal centers but contributes only its individual best center to every single/joint proposal. Joint proposals correctly recompute the mutual pair once, but never combine alternate scored centers for either owner. The recorded mutual collisions quantify this omitted finite center-combination neighborhood; they do not prove any alternate combination is better or a valid packing exists. Any broader construction must start from original source, preserve complete key minima/closed-key exclusions, charge all prior preparation and pass independent full-score/deadline checks before one bounded call. No optimized/stopping winner may seed a successor.
